description: Federal safety recalls: FDA drug, device and food recalls (Class I most severe, II, III), CPSC consumer-product recalls, and NHTSA vehicle, equipment, tire and child-restraint campaigns since 1966. One row per recall, id {source}-{recall_number}. classification is FDA-only: setting it excludes all CPSC and NHTSA rows. FDA rows typically run 4-6 weeks behind real-world recall dates (openFDA's cadence) while CPSC is current: filter by source for FDA. Search rule for recalling_firm, product_description and vehicle_model: case-insensitive; 4+ characters match anywhere, 1-3 characters match a whole word; a term of 3+ characters searches every recall, and a 1-2 character term searches only the newest 5,000 recalls the query's other filters select (the oldest, with sort_order=asc), and coverage_warning says so. NHTSA: do_not_drive and park_outside are NHTSA's owner advisories; source=nhtsa with recall_number lists the campaign's vehicles. Source: NHTSA Office of Defects Investigation; public domain (http://www.usa.gov/publicdomain/label/1.0/). Fields and sources: keyvex.com/docs/tools/get_product_recalls

classification.description: FDA only: setting it excludes CPSC and NHTSA rows.

product_description.description: Product text; search rule in the description.

recall_number.description: As filed (FDA 'D-1234-2026', NHTSA '26V652000'); with source, a direct lookup.

recalling_firm.description: Firm name; search rule in the description.

vehicle_make.description: NHTSA only. Exact make, case- and space-insensitive.

vehicle_model.description: NHTSA only. Model text; search rule in the description.

vehicles_cursor.description: With source=nhtsa and recall_number: the previous vehicles_next_cursor.

name: get_product_recalls
